text: Played this game for a very long time, my level is above 10k, now thought it's levels are impossible to complete without buying coins. No coins no progress. Went from a good relaxing game to a money grab. I do appreciate that as there is no adds and it needs to make money but a level that can not be passed unless you buy coins with real money. Just a cash grab now!

The first few levels are naturally easy because they're designed for you to win. Then the game tricks you into thinking it's helping you by giving you free power ups for either 15mins, 30mins, or an hour. The catch is you can't turn off these power ups, and they drop in the second the level starts, effectively ruining the structure of the level (as most levels start with a set up power up to activate) making it impossible to make progress while the power up you "won" is active.

Game algorithm has become incredibly difficult and they expect you to play 24/7 to complete tasks. Certain tasks are impossible to complete unless you pay. I contact support and they just respond with a generic copy & paste response. Honesty It's getting worse. I even tried paying for things and even that didnt help. No point in playing anymore. I'd rather pay another game but actually be able to progress through the levels.

I've played this game for years and really enjoyed it, now though it's the most frustrating app, if you don't spend money on the in-app purchases, you get nowhere, they have taken the ads away for extra moves, and the daily challenges that you can earn 100 coins. pretty obvious you now need to spend money to get anywhere close to moving on in the game 🤬 very unfair.

Once again having connection errors. Tried to reload game. Back to the beginning. The support for this game is terrible. Connection errors happening again. This game was fun. Recently, I lost all my bonuses, and I continually get a connection error so I don't get added to daily races. All my coins are gone. I rarely get the choice to watch an ad to get extra moves. I am about to uninstall it

The game is fun, but they definitely cheat you. You earn coins to get more prizes/features, based on certain moves. It seems like when you make moves that will earn you a high number of coins, they don't count them for that game. Update: they've made improvements, but only to get you to buy in more. A game is supposed to be random, but this is clearly programmed to get you to purchase. Once my current purchase runs out, I've got to get rid of this thirst trap of a game.

Awful since been bought out. Despite what their customer services say, levels are not passable without spending. The algorithms are unsophisticated and gambling based. You can tell within 3 or 4 moves that you're not going to succeed. What used to be a fun and logical thinking game has been ruined by greed. Don't bother downloading unless you are prepared to pay.

A fun but annoying game. It's obvious that it's nothing to do with skill, the game algorithms choose as and when you complete a level. You can be stuck on a level for days, needing to clear one more block (but needing to pay for extra moves), then you clear the level with 10 moves remaining. It's no fun being stuck for days, beginning to wonder why I bother when it is so obviously fixed. *edit* The 'Collection' is another money making scam, it is IMPOSSIBLE to complete without spending money.

The game was supposed to be a bit of Fun, but is anything but. Recent updates make it unplayable, unless of course you spend money on it or constantly watch ADVERTS, ADVERTS AND ADVERTS. There is always a move or a few left which means it is DELIBERATE set up. It makes it just another BORING money grab. There are much more entertaining alternatives. Shame, the first 11000 levels were fun. Not anymore...

This was a great game, unfortunately greed has spoilt it! Difficulty level has been turned right up, you only complete levels when the game decides to give you extra moves, so you could play the same level 30/40 times or more, unless you SPEND MONEY! The only thing that helped making levels easier was Magic Disco ball which you could do loads of levels with, that was until your now lucky if you do 1 level. Don't bother support, reported problem last July still not fixed because it benefits them.

The game seems to run to urge us to spend more and more money for upgrades. The game often causes our upgrades to fail. It also offers special events and then closes the randomly. Playstore need to investigate the business practices which encourages users including me to become almost addicted to spending increasing sums of money to keep up. If I knew then what I know now I would never have joined up and thrown away so much money.

I have been playing this game for years now and have reached level 11.400 and then some. It's fantastic but it's clear the algorithm that runs it is designed to make it almost impossible to clear levels without inapp purchasing. Collecting free lives for watching a few videos was great but has now disappeared. The daily free gift is now almost always winning trading cards and very rarely extra coins. Completing the card collection is almost impossible as you have to collect all the gold cards🤬

Like most of the reviews posted, the game started off really enjoyable, but recently has become increasingly difficult to pass these levels. I have been playing now for quite a few years and nice to pass the time. Now the enjoyment has stopped and I find myself disliking the game more and more to the point, despite reaching the Champions League, I'll just delete the game and play something else. Developers have ruined what should and could be an enjoyable game...disappointing.

Great game, but beware... I love this game; I battled throuh over 3500 levels, and yes, occasionally bought extras. It's addictive, fun and frustrating in equal measure. A classic. Simple, yet complex. Genius! Then I bought a new phone, and lost it all. You see, unless you have a Facebook account, and I don't, there is no way to save your progress and transfer to another device. Even copying system files doesnt work. Of course, I found this out the hard way. Please add another way to back up!

I have been playing for years. I don't have Facebook so I have had to reset every time I get a new phone. I have ran up to the highest level at least 5 times. But now it is impossible. I have gotten to champions league. And now it costs several hundred coins a day to play. Absolutely impossible to pass levels. I used to have 25k coins saved but am now down to 3k just trying to keep the disco ball...it's impossible to win levels without the disco ball anymore. Probably gonna delete the game soon

This game is freakishly addictive as you've probably read many times in other reviews. As you pass each level, you're hunger for more grows until you run out of lives, then you join a group, then you look at buying in app purchases! Once you've done all this and got to level 770 the game throws you out and loses all of your profile and starts you at level one again. Disappointing to say the least.

After playing for many years, I have uninstalled. I've spent a lot of money on it but I finally got sick of being stuck in the Champions League where I'd need to spend *significant* money to get through. I had numerous accounts over several devices over the years, exceeding level 10,000 more than once. But I just can't keep spending. If you'd just let me play on and occasionally top up, I would have kept going.

Completely free with zero ads! Fun enough with essentially infinite levels. Plays very quick, so great if you're on the go. Strategy basically revolves around getting a level streak going, so nothing especially deep here. That being said, if you're looking to stay busy on your phone, this is the way to do it!

The color block matching game itself is fun and easy-to-learn, a good balance of strategy and chance. Then there's the bigger setup to figure out how to play to maximize your in-game boosters and coins. It's not too annoying when encouraging in-app purchases, and if you never pay for anything, you sometimes get the option to watch ads for extra moves. 50 new levels every 14 days, and when you finish all those, you rise to Champions League: the rewards are higher, yet succeeding is way harder.

Like all pay-to-play games, when you get past the first couple hundred levels, it becomes impossible to pass most levels in one round. Unless you have unlimited life boost, the game is unplayable. It is extremely boring to play the same level dozens of times. At the point where it takes hours to pass 2-3 levels. I cannot earn boosters or coins because levels, even the 'easy" ones, are unplayable. Unless you play dozens of levels a day, you don't earn enough boosters/coins to continue. deleting.

I play another match game called Piggy Kingdom. You know why I spend most of my time there? When you run out of moves you are given an option to watch ads to get more moves. I appreciate this so much that I actually purchase coins for power ups. just thought you should know why players stop at certain levels and don't return for months if ever. In your game, if you don't have enough coins, your choices are to pay up, lose your streak and try again, or play something else. I choose the latter.

It is a free game however it is extremely difficult to make progress as the game is designed with Only One way to win without making a purchase. Therefore if You do not find that one move you are stuck there, forever. It is designed to make money not for enjoyment. I complained to support and they confirm it is designed with one move so you do not have to purchase anything... ONE.

I really like this game, but I'm tired of having to continuously update it to get new levels. What is going on with this game!?! I'm in the 11000s and it takes days, almost weeks to pass each level! That's not fun, it's boring and mundane. They've removed the option to watch ads for extra moves, so if, you don't have enough coins, you have to buy them or you're stuck.

I recently changed my review because of lack of assistance with the Ai that handles support. I have played for 9 years. I spent over $30 on the most recent Temple Guardian even. Idiotic, on my part. It won't happen again. I earned several rewards through ToonPass that I was never actually given. I had spent another$30 on that. Support was absolutely useless. Now they aren't even responding to me. if you play Do Not Give Peak any money!

used to be my favorite game. the last update, they cut the moves in half and makes it impossible to pass levels. shouldn't be stuck on 1 level for over a week. you can tell in the first 4 moves if youre going to pass it or not and when you try to watch the videos to get the extra moves, the game shuts off and deletes your streak automatically.

This game, like the other games by Peak, is a money scheme. Unless you're willing to spend money daily, the levels will be rigged so you can't win. Update. I have contacted support several times and they never resolve anything. Again, if you don't purchase their stuff you will not complete the card sets or advance. Stay away and don't waste your money! All of their games, Peak, are rigged.

I've cleared cookies, cache etc. uninstalled and reinstalled, but after the prior update...no good. what a shame. ni loved this game too.

Space miner boards are getting bigger making it harder to complete. In canon fest I now need 300 balls where 200 was enough before. The card packs is also harder with a lot more lower star duplicate cards. You are doing this to get people to spend more and more money. As someone who has played this game for years, I will quit if this trend continues 😡

this is a real hard one to review. the game is free, it has no add, so technically you can play all day long, i really really like that. also no popups that pop upt every three seconds, so there everything is perfect. But i am a fan of good usability. as a red green colorblind the symbols on the boxes are to small (but hey, they also thought of that) but the button placement on the end of levels... for every time i wasted money because i missclicked on the first day i deduct a star

I have played this game for probably 10+ yrs. I never had problems until this year. They've basically made it pay-to-play. I never put $ on this game and had an enjoyable experience for many years but now every new update makes it harder to pass levels to the point that I have actually made purchases. Big regrets ! They've set it so that no matter how far ahead you get, you are quickly set back all over again with unpassable levels, or making you play dozens of times to pass. Total scam.

This is the best game installed on my device. No pop-up ads, which is great. I have passed all levels & entered the Champions League 3 times. However, I am losing motivation to keep playing. Some Champions League stages are very hard, & you are 100% guaranteed not to pass without using coins. You can get stuck on a stage for ages. If the stages are that difficult, the rewards should be much better. Top 10 or more players should receive valuable coins & power-ups, otherwise no incentive to play!

I love this game HOWEVER over the 2 years I've been playing it, it has become basically unplayable. Like they are trying to force you to pay to play!!! 😡😡😡 This game used to be so fun, now it's just frustrating! You can't hardly progress unless you pay, such a shame! Also, don't let the pictures fool you, I've never seen that in the game. Plus, some reviews say you can watch ads to get extra moves....untrue!!!

The tier they put our team on guarantees we lose every week without even coming close to rewards with 20 plus players. The levels become ridiculously difficult for days and drain you of every resource. It's like they set you up to fail for days hoping you'll give in and pay to play. Used to love this game, but not so much any more. Would just like to say, the game just keeps getting worse. It was fun at first, but not so much any more. enjoy it for awhile.

I love this game a whole bunch, there's just one thing I want changed. I've been stuck on a level and had to repeat it constantly because there's no actual way of beating it other than using power-ups or the game currency buying you another few moves, it's extremely frustrating because I can't make a different move or choice other than the same moves that do absolutely nothing to help me progress. other than that, I absolutely love the app, it's primarily offline and gets my brain going.

I have played this game for YEARS! In fact I downloaded it when it had 10K downloads. Currently I was at level 11801 (50 new levels just released), but for the past year the game keeps resetting my progress with incentives, in game money disappears, and when I reach out to customer support I get told to completely close one devise before playing on another. which is great advice, but I only play on one device. I am just frustrated with it, so I un-installed it.

customer service is horrible! the only reason I play is because I love the game. they just want your money, please be on the lookout and be careful enjoy the game.. if you tried to contact support it is always AI I fell into the trap of making purchases wasting money and they can't even honor their own mistakes. and I'm sure it's not because they are not able to they make plenty of money off of people.

I like the game but it's very very cheap on coins (a little 5 coins or 50 coins to complete a whole prize ) compared to many other same type of games. Suggestion, if you want to keep your gamers don't be so cheap with winning coins.

I've been playing for many years. I used to love it. I've now reached a point of dislike. Once you reach higher levels, it's almost impossible to pass unless you spend money. ive been playing for over a year now. I even transferred from other cells when I got a new cell. I enjoy every minute. Keeps my brain busy. Every board is interesting. No issues or complaints. I've been playing this game for years, and it's been fun. The (new) changes are challenging and not in a fun way. the mini games start out fun until you win too much, then the rules change. They increase the requirements needed to win ridiculously. For instance, on the deep sea treasure mini game, I'd have to win 120 games on the 1st try. 120! The championship league is not fun, and you have to use power-ups to even win a game after the 14th level. I stop playing after 50. The League isn't fun.

I instantly fell in love with this game. Love the sounds, the music, the gorgeous colors that remind me of the 90s, and the gameplay is relaxing and fun. Great job guys, keep up the great work. I'm currently playing this while listening to 30 Seconds to Mars 2nd album :) (I'm older)

You have turned what was a really good game by the previous owners into nothing more than a rip off money grabbing dollar making con, made it impossible to pass through levels without spending money, cut the amount of rewards we are getting to the bare minimum, added far to many in game games with hardly any rewords, added a collection card game which is impossible to complete as your hardly giving gold cards to complete it, your not more than a typical greedy money grabbing Amarican compny

Ever since the last update the game freezes and closes whenever you try to watch certain videos, thankfully it starts again without loss of moves or special moves. You also don't get jack for accomplishing anything anymore. Used to be fun to play and kill time.

the services sucks, no refunds, no information about the game, like getting kicked off a team by not doing anything wrong, not letting chat with team, i am sure i got kick out by mistake. the items not received from a new team. use coins on, did not count because you lock on the old team. this is an amazing game with the object being to win levels and earn rewards. I am a dedicated player who had a streak of 1427 when my device died mid-level. toon Blast is a cute game, but I'm limited, because I can only afford to play it for free until I run out of tries. unfortunately, if you want to play this game longer, you have to pay. I like the cute bear named, Bruno who is the game's mascot. 🐻

once you accidentally tap the purchase button you cannot get back the free with optional ads version and will forever be spending real money to get past unwinnable levels. used to love this game. now it's a frustrating money suck.

Fun game for on or offline. Levels get more challenging the higher you go. Can get frustrating at higher levels, game seems to ensure you can't get past a level until new updated levels are added...but over all, I love the game.

New levels are too difficult. I will not be forced to buy power-ups to continue to play. I dislike pay to play and I don't. Update to developers......you guys are getting greedy again!.... 1/2 of my team no longer participates because it's too expensive to play!

I love this game. HOWEVER. This is pretty standard fair for match 3 games. it's entertaining enough, not stupid difficult early on so that's a bonus. Graphics are good, game play engaging enough but honestly it's early days, I'm only on level 9! But so far, I'm not hating it.

this game has the WORST Matchmaking Mechanics I've ever seen. our team doesn't get over 8k stars. but always paired against 3 or 4 teams that get between 12k to 18k stars. the matchmaking mechanics is horrid and their response is always the same... "we have it created to be fair".... no you don't.

this game is a blast. good graphics or appealing I should say. this game is great if you wanna pass time or get involved in with more competitive challenges. I'm in my 50's and enjoy the time spent playing toon blast.

The issue is that the player often gets a choice between buying extended play or getting more chances by watching video ads. However, the free awards often don't work, forcing the player to buy extended play for twice the amount it would cost if one got it right away. Hence, the change from 5 stars to 3

I've played Toon Blast for a long time, but I've lowered my rating, may be time to uninstall. Levels seemed rigged now, especially in Champions League, and there is no way to beat many levels with the initial amount of moves given, so you have to continually spend money. For example, I've just played a level more than 20 times and still cannot beat it without spending more money. Goal for the level is to remove 90 items, but you only get 18 moves. Total money grab!

I'm editing my review of this game because I first left a review in the early stages. After playing this game for a few weeks, I have come to the realization that the only way to advance is to spend money on boosters! When you have levels that require you to collect multiple blue matches and you don't get enough blue squares on the board to make those matches, that's a bit ridiculous. Too many boards where it's more up to the game rather than you making the right moves! Uninstall is near!

This game is not fair to all users. I have been playing this game for over 7 years and have risen through the ranks. Other new users have many options like Double Disk and Dragon Play, but I haven't received them in over 4 months now. It's not only given to paying users, but it's really unfair. Also, there were many errors where the screen would just turn off while watching an ad and you would have to start the level from the beginning again.

Use to love this game. They changed the algorithm and now can barely get passed any levels without spending money. I just spent 7 days trying to pass 3 levels. They have us in a group with top players or bots and you can never win. Not worth my time anymore. An update on the game. DO NOT PLAY IT UNLESS YOU PLAN TO SPEND MONEY!!!!! Rockets go right through bubbles and they don't pop, you try and make an arrow and bomb combo and the bomb goes off and only 1 arrow in each direction instead of 4.

Picked it up from one of the video ads on another game. The video add blatantly lied about what it was. It is not a game where you are trying to get a character through an area with traps and the puzzle helps it survive. It's just another bubble popping game. It's got its own spin, sure. But if you're here through the same method I came? Understand it's false advertising of the highest degree.

Update: The problems have been fixed for some time now and I no longer have issues. LOVE IT!! I love this game but it's CONSTANTLY crashing my phone!!! I play a few levels and then it locks up, then continues to reboot my phone. Any idea on why this happens?! I'm afraid I'll have to uninstall until that bug is fixed, once it's fixed I'll give more stars.

It's such a fun game. I like it better then candy crush. More bonuses and incentives to do better. Update: I've had this game for awhile now and I must say, while I still love the game, it constantly freezes. I have lost bonuses, lives, and already beat levels because of it. I have uninstalled and reinstalled it, and have all the updates completed, yet, I still have issues. I an down grading from 5 stars to 2 until its fixed.

I would much prefer to watch ads in order to earn more gold/points than to feel constantly pressured & manipulated to make in-app purchases. Purchases should be for special add-ins. If you can barely play the game without them, it's not really a free game and they should just charge a price up front. I deleted it after a few days, which is a shame because the game itself is a lot of fun, but it left a sour taste in my mouth.

Have been playing this game daily for over two years, and have loved it more than any other game out there. A week ago I reached the "Champions League". Trust me, there is no quicker way to turn one off of a game than to make it basically unwinnable - now I can play for days... without winning a single round. Of course, if I pay I can move forward - but otherwise? Nothing. So you reward longtime players by pushing them out. Will be uninstalling.

I started playing this on a pay to play app. I like that as soon as the app opens you can play right away, there aren't a ton of pop-ups to buy game items. and no ads, huge +. but the rescue bruno minigame has been disappointing. it's not as the ads show, I don't know why developers advertise their game showing things that aren't actually in the game? then the minigame just stopped altogether. it's been a couple hundred levels since the last rescue bruno. now it's just another match 3 game

I do enjoy playing and can get into it for hours at a time. I don't like that the challenges increase and get harder but the rewards stay the same. It's kind of a smack in the face and they know you'll keep playing once you get hooked they throw these little bonus games in but they only pay minimally. In fact, 1 of them didn't even pay enough to buy anything?! Go figure!Biggest pet peeve, can't use my stylus', all my devices have them, for a reason.

After two years.and being over 5100 levels, adios. The update is horrendous with the prizes...as someone else said, 60 mins of free play as a prize is only good if the winner has that time to play--otherwise it's an absolute waste since it can't be saved to use like coins, boxing gloves, etc. Not to mention I've come to see how this game is more manipulated than a Vegas slot machine. Even left to random chance, the way blocks fall here would never always occur, mathematically speaking.

The game is good. but one of my gripes is the fake races. The Dragon's Treasure and the Easter Bunny races already have predetermined outcomes. So. no matter how hard you try, and especially how FAST you play, you will always be set in the predetermined "winners bracket." It's not real, and it only exists to get you to play fast, possibly making mistakes so that you'd have to pay coins for power ups. Smart move for the dev. But it's BS.

Used to be the best game ever, not even containing adds, well done to the creators of this awesome game. But the further you go up the levels the more ridiculously hard it gets, getting stuck on levels for weeks is taking out all the fun it used to be. Thinking of rather deleting this game of my phone and look for something more fun and relaxing.

Good until the higher levels then easily a setup for $. I've played this game about 1260 levels, when I hit about 800 I noted a subtle difference in how "close" you would come to finishing a level, repeatedly, and started keeping track of each level attempted and how close I could get. It soon became clear that the "random" arrangements or new items dropping, weren't quite as random as they'd like you believe. The number of helping items dropped forcing you to spend $ for that one last move.

I don't understand how this game has such a high rating after seeing so many negative reviews. Very sus. It's a total money grab. You can tell when the game decides you've played enough for the day without spending money, because the levels suddenly get impossible to beat. Until you either pay them or wait a few days that is. Then suddenly you beat a round first try. Again extremely sus. It's nice there's no ads tho. Just constant spamming to purchase things. Overall I would not reccommend.

"Random rocket direction" statement is a lie. The "random" direction of the rockets completely depends on the level structure. In most of the cases the developer controls the rockets direction so that you don't pass the level easily. Update: uninstalled the game, since it's no more fun, because the more close you to the finish, the hardest to pass the levels. It intentionally makes you lose.

I got bored after all of my lives had been used, so while waiting for them to renew, I took the app apart and found that they have written the program so that if you dont buy any of their power ups, the game difficulty increases massively, very quickly. If you do buy their powerups, it is a fun game to play. So it is not pay to play, it is pay to advance. You can play without purchases, but very, very difficult. Once I removed those lines of code, it was a good game to play. Dont recommend

Very addictive... Love it!! Above was my original review. Now, some years later, I still like the game but have lost interest in it. The developers have changed the rewards system, and the game seems at times impossible to move forward. As such, I'm less inclined to play as much as I used to. Before the update, it was challenging but loads of fun as well.

I'd give this game 5 out of 5 if it wasn't for the long, repetitive ads and coin, power-ups cap limit! Accumulating stuff is part of the fun, but this game kills it with limits, especially once nothing else left to accomplish for those who maxed out on everything and done with the latest episode! Even an increase would be nice for a change! But on the plus side,that was helpful to explore other games that turned to be a lot of fun "so far",like Royal Match, haven't hit a limit on that one yet!😄

If you want a fun time passer, this is NOT the game for you. If you enjoy a few simple levels followed by infuriatingly difficult levels, then download this game! It has cute cartoon characters, but only still pictures of them, no animations. It does have some fun levels. I've played some 300 levels, and overall liked it. But now the levels are not just difficult, they seem designed to punish you for playing. Unless you have plenty of items to use in the level. The game will give you some good ones to use, but often you still will not complete the level.

Features randomly break. For a long time I couldn't chat with teammates...my chats didn't post, none of them. Now the free hammer for 15 minutes reward doesn't work. This has gone on several weeks and the support crew was wrong when they said it was a timer problem in my phone because when I win unlimited lives for 15, 30, or 60 minutes that always applies correctly. Players are unable to reset their progress easily so we can't fix issues like this by starting over.

have played this game off and on for years, rarely making in-app purchases. but 1 day ago as I was playing, I made several purchases within the game, until for some unknown reason the purchase seemed to have vanished. Didn't think much of it, even continued playing today. But for whatever reason my keyboard had transitioned from english to chinese. I speak and write only english. I then got a message from my security app alerting me of 2 breaches. I deleted the game and any other games related.

Game was fun until I got to the point where it feels like you needed to purchase boosts in order to progress. Yeah you get some free but when you have to attempt a stage 20+ times because of bad "luck" you burn through those really quick. Also the lack of being able to replay stages to get more stars for the bonus chest further compounds this. I think a game should be fun to play whether you spend money or not, playing the same stage over and over is not.

Eventually the levels are almost impossible. I'm playing the same level 50 times just hoping that the tiles line up right so you can finish it. They make money by selling you tools you need to beat most levels. No skill involved at all. You can only lose so many times until you run out of lives and have to buy more or wait 30 minutes for another life.

Makes you spend to win. The developers claim it's "random" and they don't manipulate it. If it's truly random then they shouldn't be able to designate certain levels as hard and very hard. However they do, so it's not random as they claim. Just spent 27 straight minutes on one level and I still had to use extra moves and helps to solve it because every single time I would be just a few moves short.

I am lowering my initial review. While it is still one of my favorite games, they prompt you to play on and don't ask for confirmation to spend 100 coins. The natural tendency is to hit play on instead and it is usually not an issue as I don't have enough coins. if I do have 100 coins and was saving it for 5 free lives, I sometimes accidentally use it on a level where there is no way I can finish in 5 more moves. Bruno Bear would not approve.

Fun, happy, simple, and doesn't get so hard you just quit. Still some challenge but nice play overall. Lots of boosters and prizes without having to spend money. No adds! Love it! Only thing is I wish we could go back and replay levels to get all the stars, but i guess because the ongoing tournaments i don't know...you can testart a level if you loose though. So that's good.

I've been playing this game for years. A lot of the updates to the game make the game unenjoyable. I hate that there are levels with watermelons, bottles, etc. that need more than 1 match to blow up and you only get 15 moves. Being stuck on a level for 3-5 days automatically drops you out of the daily challenges because you can't move forward to gain stars. You can't do anything unless you have the disco ball. It's a bust now. Not worth playing anymore.

I hate the "Pay to Win" design, after a certain point if you don't have the gold to extend the game or the perks to help you out, it can take 10 or 20 tries to finish a level. The "Buy/Spend More Gold" screen is the primary choice on the "You Lose" screen... The whole game is designed to get you to spend money, even with the competions, the perks you win don't last long enough to finish the next competion, I recommend you don't get hooked, you'll be a couple hundred dollars down before you know it... I don't begrudge the makers some income, but find a better way, cause I've lost interest...

It's very addictive. As you climb the ranks be ready to spend tons of money as the game will make it so. Reason is that the game will let you almost win but you still need to clear one or two more items thus spending more money to clear the level. It'll then maybe let you pass a couple more and do it the same thing for a couple of more levels thus you having to spend more money to pass the level. I finally got tired of this and uninstalled the game. Instead of enjoying the game, it became stress

As noted by so many others, good game, but obvious the owners have control. As soon as you're on a winning streak you no longer have access to buying options to continue, or access to cust serv, or glitches start happening. When you send requests for help, no one responds, but suddenly the glitch is fixed but you will have lost your standing in that particular competition. Almost impossible to get help or to win the ultimate prizes. Too bad, I've played for years but will now delete

I have been playing Toon Blast for several years. I admit I am addicted to it. I have reached the upper levels, and it is frustrating to get stuck for days on a level. Even with the mirror ball and other earned boosts, there are levels you can't beat. I have been paying for the Team Pack every weekend to help myself and my teammates. I can't justify the cost. I have teammates who are no longer playing anymore. I might leave, too.

Great game, if the algorithm didn't play against you so much. I have been playing for a few years. I was reading some of the comments yesterday that they watched ads to earn lives and rewards. I have not seen any ads to be able to do that in Toon Blast. it would be nice to be able to do that instead of shelling out money just to be able to play and move forward. Our group is slowly dwindling away. Out of 46, we have maybe 6 to 8 active members. That says something is wrong. Still 4 stars.

Others may be easier to please but I found several aspects of the game play wanting. There is, so far as I can see, no way to replay levels to try for more stars once a level is completed. Which makes scoring against other Facebook users pointless. Level difficulty is inconsistent at best. Finally, tile generation does not seem to be truly random thus skewing the game play toward mere chance rather than skill. Game graphics are okay but they're not anything in the 'wow' range. In short, it is a

I'd been playing Pet Rescue Saga for several years and hadn't really found anything like it that I enjoyed as much. This game is it! Same concepts behind the color matches (which I really love), but a unique set of challenges and strategies. Lives can go pretty quickly if you get hung up on a level, and they don't refill as quickly as PRS. But you have an option to either join (or form your own) a team, and teammates help provide free lives and win team challenges. Great game!

I've been playing this game for 6 or so months. It started out very fun. Lately, it's ridiculous. The game 'knows' if you have helps (extra rockets, punches, etc) and OFTEN levels cannot be won until these are depleted. That's very frustrating. Of course, you can BUY extra coins to use for these things. I'm above level 5000 now. Of course it's supposed to get more challenging, but on average, I stay stuck on 1 level for @5-10 trys. And I no longer see Save Bruno levels.

A really fun game with catchy tunes until you get to the upper levels. Even using boosters at round 341/342 it was impossible to complete. It seems like you will never be able to complete them without buying stuff which I refuse to do. Game started off great and then went into the beyond frustrating stage so I deleted it. I give it two stars because it was fun but not anymore.

Disappointed. I had high hopes for this game seeing as how there are no ads popping up after every turn. But when you buy coins for more turns its $1.99 once and a $1.99 a second time and then you have no choice but to pay $7.99 if you want any more coins than that and that's just a little ridiculous. In all the other games I play like this you can buy coins for $.99 $.99 $ .99 until you're broke. The gameplay is fun the rescue games are fun but I'm installing because of the rip-off.

So, in the ads with Ryan Reynolds, the game seems fun and simple and probably a game for children (time consuming, easy, not a pay to play deal... well it's not. I got to level 261 and realized it's a money pit just like every other game. It's fun for a bit while the attempt to suck you in. And it worked on me for about $20. And I'm gone. Don't let them suck you in.

So here's the skinny... I'm giving Toon Blast strictly a 3/5, not because of flaws, boredom, or ads, or anything like that. [It's] because it's just ANOTHER match game and, despite its claim of the absolute lack of ads on another in-game ad, there are PLENTY of ads, so, false advertising. Ads... I really don't care about. However, ads that misrepresent the product that they are advertising, well, that's just dishonest. Hopefully, this review is a little more helpful than some of the others...

I play this game all the time, but the crowns are a trap - most levels are actually easier to beat without the automatic powerups, and it costs coins to add moves after you lose the level, which generates profit for the gamemakers. it seems like something that would help, but it is a trap! I just let myself lose a life, and the crown, and usually, I beat the level within one or two tries after that. the automatic powerups can really mess a good game up.

I really loved this game for a long time. And I like that you can get free extra moves by watching an ad. What I hate, is having to watch 3, 30 second ads to get 5 moves. That just greed. I should only have to watch 1 ad for 5 moves. I've been playing this for years and now I'm seriously thinking of deleting it.

This is supposed to be fun!! I'm a legal professional who works extremely hard every day & this game is my wind down. Games by design are supposed to be fun, enjoyable, & winnable! If my goal was to be challenged mentally, there are many other options to pick from. I like to "be a winner" without having to spend half my paycheck or without wasting countless hours trying to get past a level that can't be passed without paying! In this challenging world, I'd just like to have some mindless fun!!

What used to be a fun game has become nothing more than a cash grab. Levels and advancing are near impossible without purchases. I'd rather watch ads than to deal with the overly greedy tactics this game continues to employ. Update 07/01 - found myself playing less and less. The developers canned cut and paste response is pathetic. Perfect of example of what not to do to keep players engaged. Sad, it used to be a great game...

The game is lots of fun, and as one progresses, it becomes increasingly challenging. The randomness ensures there's no specific solution. Be very careful about purchasing anything: if you buy, say, 6 hours of free lives, you will lose about an hour because the transitions between screens is deliberately slowed down. If you buy power ups to give yourself an advantage, you'll find that, for example, on starting a level, the power ups will randomly be in the most useless spots. Support is awful.

I've played this game for years, love the game! currently on level 11,101. They used to have a thing where if you lost on a level you could either pay 100 coins to get 5 more tries, (or was it 3?) or watch an ad to get them. They took away the ad choice which, sometimes I would prefer to watch an ad. I had over 12,000 coins not long ago and now have under 100 so I either have to play the same level several times to beat it, or I have to buy coins. Please bring back the ad choice! 😁

Well this game is really great, I've been playing for sometime now (level 1128) but I guess there was an update recently and now it's just frozen anytime I open the app. Not cool! Fix it. Also there has been 3 instances where I'd pass a level and if I get a call or something that needs my attention it makes me do the level ALL OVER AGAIN! And that's not fair because sometimes it takes me days to pass a level. So fix these issues please.

It's a good toilet game, but after a certain point it just becomes pay-to-play. It's obviously algorithm-controlled, as you can be banging away on a level for quite some time, then suddenly get all the right combos. Wanna waste some time? This'll do it. Want something that's fair and balanced? Mobile gaming isn't going to be it.

This game is highly addictive, but It gets so difficult over time that its nearly impossible to win without making in-game purchases. I would say this is by design to get people to fall victim of their own impulse to purchases in-game perks to win rounds. It's a fun game to play especially if your willing to pay play. This pay to win model (later in the game) is why I give it one stare, and why I wouldn't recommend this app.

I used to love this game even though you could clearly tell the game would purposely have you lose with only a couple moves needed so you would spend money. I would spend a few books to clear the board. However, when my phone is charging, I use my spouses cell to play, and he has never made a purchase. On his version, he gets a choice to watch video for extra moves. He also has challenges, and if completed, you get 5 coins. So, if you want to be able to the level for free, NEVER make a purchase.

Toon Blast is not as awesome as the ads make it seem. There has NEVER been a time where i only had to play with two colors. It's all random colors at a time. With this app, you will definitely NOT get what you see on the adds. I played it before, but I don't like how they advertise their app. Make it seem like the REAL thing. Otherwise, you're just misguiding people with your advertisements.

The game is pretty fun but when you're own a team the team leader should have the option to remove a member who has not been actively playing for a certain period of time. One other thing, the game has a manipulation trap to ensure you to spend money, staying on a level numerous times and I love the ones where you need 2 more moves but, need 3. Luckily I'm a glutton for punishment and will continue to play without spending money of course.

The game is deceiving, when receving treasure chest it may sometimes reward a disco ball, which you cant use, essentially it robs you of a useful item. It also isn't like the commercials and trailers, where they show many groupings of the same color for epic explosions. It will give very poor groupings sometimes wasting 4-5 moves before allowing you to proceed with the puzzle.

This is the most infuriating game I've ever played. Your algorithm is lousy. It stops being fun and makes players angry. After a while the algorithm begins giving you terrible moves until you run out of lives. Then, if you use 100 coins to refill your lives, you magically start getting good moves again. Imagine that. Deleting after a few months of playing. Even "easy" levels are too hard requiring the magic disco ball to win. We need to be able to buy the magic disco ball for 100 or 200 coins.

This has been my go to game to help with anxiety while watch tv or at the end of the day. It's become impossible to pass levels. Lives aren't renewed often enough. Team members can only help with 5 lives. It isn't so much the being stuck that's aggravating it's the stuck constantly but usually only on the weekends during the team tournament. I've spent money on this game. I won't again. Finding a different game.

What was once a great time killer has turned into a cash grab. They've lessened the rewards, not everyone had the option to watch ads (so I had to spend money to get extra moves) and the algorithm is SO bad. 1 hour of free lives and can't pass one level... absolute time waste and that's not what people want. Actual gameplay is OK. You got 2 stars TB only because one of them is for me putting up with this garbage for years.

The game is nothing like the ads they use. Even the cartoon graphics are worse than what is seen in the ads. The game itself is ok, but the levels get repetitive very quickly, and the "puzzles" are not really puzzles at all. Adding "ice" that you need to clear before clearing the tiles does not make it a puzzle. For a genre that has hundreds of similar games, this one is nothing special, like their ads would have you believe. Just another clickbait ad farm.

This was a enjoyable game but like always it turns into a game about money. Once you get pass the 7000 level they take moves and bonus away from you. So in order to pass levels you have to play the same level multiple times or purchase things to help pass the level. I wish I was talented and rich enough to where I could make a game that is enjoyable to play no matter what level you get to and you wouldn't have to spend money. Will be uninstalling today.

I already left a comment and after 2 days on same level tired of it. It might be good when you are on low levels but once high up it is frustrating. When you watch videos of people solving it, it only helps when you get same cubes. At the end you either spent money or consider a new game. I'm considering now something new. Don't mind spending every once in a while money, but thats to much now. Also I'm a quick in between player and these 15 min wins that you have to use right away are pointless

Fun at first but after about level 250 it gets to the point where you get stuck on boards for a day or two unless you spend money on items to get through them. The higher you go the worse it gets. The rocket power ups always seem to spawn the opposite direction of what you need them to also. it gets really annoying. I won't be wasting another dollar in this game and will be uninstalling it.

Used to be fun but now it sucks. Deliberately throttles players who are advancing through the levels, crashes, lost bonuses after not playing for a few days as well. The only thing that keeps me from just deleting it permanently is good team members that I've played with over the years but even that might not be worth it. There are some bonus games like the hat game. I don't even understand the point of it. Randomly had ads to add more levels for a while but they stopped. Seems disjointed.

Rating the game down. Reached level 1700, and it's almost impossible to get through levels now. Have to use all boosters/power-ups/coins saved. It does often feel like the tiles you get make it impossible to pass.  Should be able to reset game and start fresh from level 1. With a bit more know-how, it would allow players to collect more boosters/power-ups/coins to pass levels later on. Now it's just frustrating.  Also frustrating: got kicked from a team by mistake, and same thing happened to my friend now. Really liked the team, but once you've been kicked, you cannot join again. This is a major flaw! Leader should be able to 'unblock' you, so you can join again.

Getting too difficult to proceed to the next level. I've been stuck on the same level for days sometimes, especially if it is the last level before the arena. Rockets are NOT random, I just had 8 lined up in one level where I needed 3 to go down to complete the game and guess what, they all went across. This used to be an enjoyable game. Reading the feedback, lots of people want it back the way it was so maybe you should listen to them.

getting stuck on levels for days is not fun. impossible to beat without spending money. been playing for 8 years and been champion league for a long time. no longer the option to watch ads for more moves makes it impossible to beat levels without spending money. been stuck on a level for 3 days. time to delete this game and find something else to play. direction is definitely not random.

Game is fun and a great way to pass time. But I've had issues with beating a level and exiting game, to come back and do the level over again because it didn't give me credit for what I accomplished. (I always thought I was wrong or maybe missed something, so I waited to make sure I was on the next level before exiting, and even wrote down the number.) I've spent money on this game (way more than I'd like to admit) to not get the full package of what I've purchased. I've had to delete.

I'm going to leave this review for people who have little to no experience playing this game. I have been playing Toon Blast for FREE since early 2018, meaning I have never spent a dime getting any moves, coins, etc. I am currently on level 9,051. I'm living proof that you can complete over 9k levels as a free player. It wasn't always easy, and gameplay has changed a lot over the years to make the levels harder to pass. But I'm still enjoying it. The ads are totally fake, by the way.

No full stars because this game goes from casual to challenging within a few levels. you cannot repay levels. pay to win and reliance on 'lives' is heavily present. the most disappointing thing to me is that there's isn't any free to play mode where you can play until you have no more moves or something. potential to be great but lacking in many areas overall.

I'm at level 500 now. ever since I got to level 400 the game has been getting ridiculously hard. Like the colours don't match up and so I spend needless amount of time on the same level. The reason I liked this game was because of the lack of thinking needed to play it. It's the reason I turned to this game and stopped playing Candy crush saga. I think I'm going to discontinue playing this game. If it doesn't get better. Update: I've uninstalled this game. I don't like a game I play on my phone that puts me through a pensive mood to beat it. I'm frustrated. Just better to uninstall

I used to love this game but lately the developers changed the algorithm and every level has been unpleasant and extremely difficult to complete. Not fun anymore. I have reached their highest levels multiple times. Looks like they want to slow down the progress so they might have intentionally upped the difficulty level.

This game was pretty good for the first few episodes. But it all went downhill once the clams are introduced. When i got to episode 13, ALL the levels were just utter trash, so i deinstalled it then and there. So yeah, pretty fun to do a few levels every now and then. Might take you somewhere between 6 Months and a year to get to the garbage, depending on how mich you play at a time. But yea, hope the intern who designed the levels for episode 13 was fired for it.

Does not show many ads, instead deciding to charge too much for packages. The most useful one, coins, of course is charged higher than the rest in proportion. Basically forced into some choices in order to keep coins available for the many times you will be just one or two moves away from a win. other items are cheaper, but usually don't have much use towards winning.

I downloaded this game after seeing an ad that made it look really fun and engaging. However, upon installing it, I was extremely disappointed to find that it was nothing like the advertisement. The gameplay was completely different and not as advertised. It feels really misleading and, to be honest, quite unethical. I hope the developers take this feedback seriously and consider being more honest with their advertising. Gamers deserve transparency and fair play.

Same as others are saying. The game was fun at first, then it stops giving you options to watch add for extra moves, and you only needed 1 more move to win the level. Nope, you have to pay. Pay! Pay! Pay! This game costs too much to play and have fun. They want you addicted and paying money to play. I'm good! A few months ago, I would have given 5 stars. Sadly!

This game was fun for a while but with each recent update I enjoy the game less and less. If you're going to replace the coin rewards with game play then there needs to be a way to bank the game play. Sometimes I'm just playing to fill the time while waiting and don't have an hour to play. Also if you're going to lean heavy into the ads you should make sure they actually work correctly. Countless times I selected watch ad but then the game freezes and I have to force close.

So I've always found the ads for this game to be pretty annoying, but one eventually piqued my interest and I gave it a try. I'm pleasantly surprised by the quality of this game. The graphics are nice and smooth, it doesn't bog you down with an actual storyline but you still get a sense of moving forward, and best of all? The game doesn't punish you for playing. Too many mobile games these days take lives/hearts from you for just playing a level. Any given Mario game won't take lives from you just for playing a level, so why do devs think it's okay to do that on mobile? This game only takes a heart when you fail a level, which is more gratifying because then it feels like my error rather than an arbitrary punishment for enjoying the game. I can go several levels without losing a heart, which is nice to pass the time. A wise development choice imo.
