Too many levels are stupidly hard. And I hate retrying constantly just to get lucky once. 150 balloons limited moves, start having to waste power ups as that's insufficient to clear. Just an exercise of frustration and not fun. Personally I'd love to see the dev himself play and see how he does at his own game. That would be amusing. In reality this game is just like all the others with stupidly hard levels designed to make you waste power ups.j

Fun game but once you reach higher levels it gets more aggravating the fun. I would rather have the option to start over but that has been removed. It syncs and refreshes. I understand this for people who had to change phones or delete the app but would enjoy the option to start over. That's why I don't create an account or connect to Facebook

I like winning the unlimited game play. I wish you had a way to save to use later. A lot of time I only get a few minutes because I was play during break at work or waiting for an appointment and you lose most of the free play. To those that say you have to spend money to advance, I am on level 4600 something and I have spent about 10.00

Looks like I'm not the only one that had complaints about the changes . It's too bad it was a fun fun fun game . It was still tough the higher you go I love the challenge. But i go days now not being able to pass a level. You took all the fun out if it. This was a pretty nasty , drastic plethora of changes . It really sucks and it's sad. I enjoyed playing this game now I just want to uninstall.

I have had a good time playing this game! I am well pass 16000 and I have not purchased any perks. It is not a cash cow. You have to have patience to play. Play the game, don't let the game play you. If you get stuck so what? I have taken days to get past some levels. If you pay to get past a level, just remember that board will come up several times. So are you going to buy your way out every time? Walk away for a while and always stay in cue to ask and give lives. Save your money!

Competitive! I love being on a team that uses the chat and give lives. There are mini games throughout the week to collect more coins or tools. It does get more challenging has a player levels up, and sometimes you get stuck on a level for days. But, just roll with it and accept that sometimes your given lemons in life.

The game is a lot of fun but some of the levels are too difficult for the amount of moves available. It takes the fun out of the game when you feel frustrated because you are so close but limited to an unrealistic amount of moves....even with the helpers. (rockets, bombs, ect.)

Entertaining if you are bored & just want to clear board after board. Cartoon characters have nothing to do with game play. "New episodes are announced, but play goes on exactly the same. Nothing like the "ads" with which we're inundated during other games. Cute game, but disappointing, overall.

This used to be a 5-star game. Now, if you play the side games you don't get the levels you passed. I've had 2 globes, and it gives me a bomb and arrow and costs me coins to keep playing. The same thing has happened with bomb and arrow, and it just did 2 arrows. Fix your damn game.

First you started by lessening the Adventure Island prizes!! Now you have done the same to the extra moves you can earn after watching an advertisement!! You won't get 5 stars from me until the rewards are increased to the previous amounts! Also, trying to earn the extra moves, you have made them more difficult by saying that the ad is not ready!! It's frustrating and unfair!!

I would give 5 stars because I enjoy playing. Have had the app for a long time. However, I've been stuck on level 3480 for weeks. Even watching ads to get extra moves you can't beat it. I'm not paying money to try and advance. I'll delete the app first. If can't beat the level pretty soon that's just what I'll do. Not paying to play a game you don't win anything but levels on.

Addictive. Need to give more stuff when you join a team, not just lives. We should be able to gift boosters to other team members too. It's funny to see people complain that the game is fixed cause they can't pass higher levels. it's called a challenge. As for taking days to pass levels, it's called strategic planning. Lol

It's fun but I will be uninstalling. It's very rare that you can win a level without making a purchase. I can't afford to make purchases every level. And for 100 coins you only get 5 moves. It's just a money trap & that's not for me. Also I have yet to see any of the games advertised in their relentless ads. So over it. Bye Bye

This was a fun game, but the developers have gotten greedy! The price for the Toon Pass doubled!!! The rewards are getting cheaper, and the first levels of the Carnival Craze which used to be free now costs $14.99 to get anything! I used to buy team passes and the Toon Pass, I won't anymore just on principle.

One of those games where you never have enough moves and they want you to buy moves with real money. Of course the game doesn't give you much when you win a level, so you keep replaying levels till you run out of lives. Frustrating. These kind of games are designed to make you spend real money and their packs are not cheap. I can see some people spending a fortune. Not me. If I'm going to spend real money on a game, I'll own it. Plus the game is nothing like the ads show. Uninstalling.

I like this game, it's fun EXCEPT one should be able to have fun w/o having to spend money. Th amount of coins you win are too few vs th amount you have to pay to keep going. Example: you have to remove 193 of one thing & 50 of another & you have 15 moves to accomplish that. WTHeck. After 5 tries, I'm out of lives & now this game isn't fun but frustrating. I uninstalled. Don't waste your time.

I enjoy the game very much, but there are some things I don't care for. I don't care for the fact that you have to do certain things in order to continue playing...like join a team...I should have a choice whether I want to or not. I also agree with someone else's comment about trying to complete a level. It took me about four days to finally get passed one, but when I can just play it, I really do enjoy it.

This game is decent in the earlier levels but becomes geared towards the player, spending money for boosters to advance. Certain levels are unbeatable without boosters, and then, after days of trying, an update will be required, and that level will simply be gone w/o defeating it. As will any money or boosters you used trying. Often, the levels limit your plays until the last few moves, then sets you up to get close to defeating it, but that's just a ploy to encourage you to spend.

While the gameplay is good and the boards are a fun way to pass the time I find myself getting frustrated with waiting on load times. 12 seconds to go to the main screen then 5 seconds on the main screen then another 12 seconds to load the next board. Add another 10 seconds if I need to open either of the chests. It begins to feel like I'm spending more time waiting on the game than I am playing it. It good but begins to get annoying if you don't multitask while you play.

It was fun, for a while. The game starts out pretty easy and fun. Once you hit a certain level, it is almost impossible to clear a level without many power ups. If you decide not to pay for power ups, expect to take 15-20 tries per level before the game finally let's you win. Also, since you only have 5 lives that refill every 2.5 hours, you end up playing for about 8 minutes. I dont begrudge Peak trying to make a buck, bit to make the game impossible to win without paying is kind of crummy.

Used to be my favorite game for yearssss. Now, the levels are so hard to beat without any help and they took the star/level rewards away (the new rewarding system is awful). AND, now the tournaments get HALF the coins?! I always bought coin packs because I wanted to...now they've made it so you have to. Uninstalling. This is ridiculous!

Not as advertised at all. I knew it had puzzle-type levels but was really looking forward to the levels as advertised where you eliminate blocks to save the character. Played for a few days and on level 160 and still nothing like it said it was. Just another puzzle/block popping game which is fine if that's what you are looking for. Kinda boring, slow moving. Would like to play the levels advertised.

This game gets difficult for me, so I usually only play for an hour or so a day when lives are free, but honestly, I definitely recommend this game. I have chronic severe pain along with ADD, but this keeps my brain distracted. I like that it is challenging, and while I get frustrated, it is worth it when I win. While I sometimes run out of lives before I move on, one of my favorite things about this game is how often I'm able to play for free. 10/10, do recommend!

I have played this game off and on for a few years now, I get annoyed with getting stuck on a level for days at a time (which is beyond ridiculous) and will stop playing/uninstall for awhile.... But the worse thing I have come across so far is the complete UNFAIRNESS in this game.... In my team we have several players that are given an option at the end of their boards to watch an add to get 3 more moves, However in all the yrs I have played I (and others) have never been offered this. FIX IT

This game is very well done. Great gameplay, great cartoon art and no ads! Although I'm almost level 400 and I still have yet to see any levels that resemble the screenshot that attracted me to the game in the first place. I'd spend money on this game if you got more for the price. 100 coins for 1.99? Not worth it. Maybe 1000 coins. Ect

BEST GAME EVER!! I REALLY like the new "5 moves left" banner!! 👏👏👏 It helps me realize when I'm almost out of moves, so I can strategize better!! In the past, I would be so into playing, that I didn't realize it was my last move until I played it!! One negative is, the button you press to spend 100 coins to get 5 more moves, shouldn't be green or in the same spot as the one we hit to contine playing. Because of this, you hit this button accidently, out of force of habit, and lose coins!!

I've been playing for a very long time. I've made in app purchases and don't mind because the game has helped me pass the time when I needed it and I love to help developers...especially when you can tell there is time spent on regular updates. However, I'm not a fan of this most recent update. It's gotten MUCH harder to pass a level and I was use to the old reward system when you do finally pass the it.

No money required to play. Has "limits" so you don't get trapped playing forever (oblivious to time spent), but still very easy to lose an hour or more. Random parts don't feel that random - like the logic is playing against you at times. Hard to find a team without players that have gone idle. I've tried to keep "Fission" active.

Games great on the phone. In December I had over 6 000 coins. Now I'm down to 500. I'm at level 10,221 or something. Keep playing same level over and over to no avail. Not getting any ads even when I'm a couple moves away. Very annoying. Makes me want to delete it. Our team is always in the top 4 on weekends. It's almost like we're being punished for doing well.

Wasn't sure if I should trust it, because of all the marketing, but I like Ryan Reynolds & funny commercials, so I gave it a shot. It's well designed, pretty intuitive, and a lot of fun. Also, easy to walk away, and I like that when I run out of lives I have an incentive to stop and do something different. Bravo.

Blatant money grab. You can see on the very first tutorial level where this was once a good game, stealth nerfed to drive players to the item shop. It's not even done very well, there's like 7 well blended colors in an 8x8 grid. Someone deleted the system for additional colors for increasing difficulty, and just set it as a flat global max value.

"Wowzers!" Had to quote my dude, Inspector Gadget on this one. I can see why the ad for this kept popping up. I just gave in, and installed it. One of THE BEST level completion animations I've ever experienced. If you love video games, give in and go. It really is a blast 😁

I love this game! I've been playing more than 2 years. I am on the very best team! I have one question, do you have other games in this team format, because I'm in for sure, if you do. Also, you don't need to spend money to be successful and have fun. After awhile, you get better at it and sometimes you get stuck she have to wait 20 minutes for another life. stop complaining; this is one of the very best games I've ever downloaded.

The recent changes to the game have made it horrible. This game used to be great and fun and the game rewards/tolkens decently obtainable. Now it's frustrating and to really win you have to pay $$. Plus must tokens can only be used the instant you win them and only used for a short period of time. Now, the game just sucks.

While this game is interesting and WAS something I enjoyed a great deal, especially the tournaments, the developer has done one too many TWEAKS. The game is ruined. There is no way to accrue coins for the tournament on the weekend. This was probably done so that more REAL coins will need to be spent for game coin. Although I've played for years, this may well be the end for me. Developer, you are alienating long time enthusiasts. Wake up and smell the coffee!

I can see a developer wanting a return on their time so I've waited a couple days before I commented about the update. That way I could ensure I didn't use inappropriate language. I would like the coin prizes brought back. Sure the 15 minute prizes are okay for a once in a while change up, but being able to build up your coin reserves (especially when your whole team does it too), really helps in the competitions. Please heed all these new comments asking for you to return to paying out coins.

Used to be a good game but has lost all it's good points over time. Lowered the top prize for the weekend challenge. No more bonuses after 10 levels. No more coins for the 150 star team challenge. And that bar challenge at the top is the stupidest thing ever. We realize it's the same 5 prizes over and over. DO BETTER PEAK!!!!

Toon Blast play was going fine until around level 40 (best guess). I would be in the middle of a game and web browser Microsoft Edge™ would randomly start. No purchase/ads are in the game play area (always present but easily avoided). I recently began using Edge on my mobile so that might have something to do with it. Sometimes my phone became completely unresponsive and I had to wait 15 minutes in order to access a phone restart. Entertaing game overall. Please check for MS Edge™ compatibility

Having so many issues since last update - including connection errors, purchases being made but not showing in app, cards not being able to be sent, time outs - I've sent emails and Facebook Messenger and support requests but no one has got back to me! I've been playing for about five years so this is disappointing to say the least!

I have been playing this game for a few years. Love it. But now, when you click to watch an ad to get extra turns, there are ads that autoinstall games, don't let you get back to ToonBlast, you lose the level anyway and you have to uninstall a game you never wanted in the first place. Brought this to their attention multiple times to no avail. Done.

I enjoy playing this game. when I first started my connection was terrible with the Ipad I was on, so I changed to another one and had the same problem. I notified my leader and wanted my names to be dropped. That was last year. Please tell me how I can drop the names so other people can join our team. I really like this game a lot, can't put it down.

Very similar to Toy Blast. However, at the beginning levels it is a lot easier and thus more fun to succeed faster. Playing as teams helps earn points faster. Unfortunately now I'm hooked! Just had to get a new phone! I was at level 6331 and data did NOT transfer! Grrrrrrrr. I like the game but probably won't play it as often as I don't want to waste the time to do what I've already succeeded at.

Fun at first, not so much when you have to play a level over and over and over and over and over. 'Random' arrows go the opposite to what you need 90% of the time, and you need more moves than the game gives you. The higher the level the more pay-to-win it becomes, since you need a crapton of boosts and extra moves, and you need to buy coins to get them. The game gives you 15 or 20 coins every 20 levels, and the boosts are 100-400. If frustration is your thing, you've come to the right app.

This game is a great way to pass time. However, I'm going to lay off of it for a while. There have been times when I was stuck on a level for days and you can't help but assume that the algorithms are being tampered with. And last night, I was in first place in the champion's league with another player close behind. I haven't seen my prize winnings in either case that I came in at first or second. It just "glitched" out. 🙄 Fun game to pass time. Just don't take it seriously.

I've been trying to load the game for couple days now with no luck but 1 time it did load and all my progress was deleted so I had to start back from beginning. It only played couple levels then booted me out and since then it won't load again. I would rate this game a perfect 5 before all this happen. Is there anything you can do to fix the problem and restore all my progress?

This game is really fun until you get to higher levels and it gets near impossible to beat without buying stuff. There is no way to start back at the beginning since it saves your progress even if you uninstall it. So it's great until it isnt because you've been on the same level for the last 25 lives.

It's a great game, I got a good and really supportive team. I love that but I remove the one star because it's hard to get more powerups in the game as you go up the levels plus they should help us get more extra moves so we could finish some hard levels instead of getting stuck on a level for a couple of weeks.

avoud this "free" game at all costs. it starts out well which is probably why the rating is good. by the mid 100-200 levels you experience the cash grab. its impossible without using up premium options. it also values a team concept but makes finding a good team extremely difficult. forget creating your own team as there is no way whatsoever to recruit or invite members. awful cash grab.

I do like it but... the action one gets when using loads of bombs, etc at the same time are a bust! Should do more damage to the board than it does. Seems kinda cooked to "fornicate" with the player. Annoying. Lastly, are you aware the app isn't working at all right now. Opens then hangs & no buttons work at all either. (Dec. 7) Thanks.

This is a very enjoyable and fun game. I like the team playing aspect with the ability to communicate with my team through the chat. But one HUGE problem is that it is WAY too easy to hit "play on" by accident. That discourages me from purchasing extra coins because I am afraid that I am going to waste my money. You really should add a confirmation step after the "play on " button is clicked.

If not for some annoying little issues such as losing progress, useless support, & being forced to open a facebook account if you want to maintain current progress when you get a new phone, (I refuse), this would be an easy 5 star game. Also see no reason why players can't have the option to go back & play past levels, especially when no game play is possible while awaiting new level updates. Love no ads interrupting.

Like many of it's predecessors dating back to tetris, Toon Blast is a great time sink and can be stimulating as a randomized puzzle. Ultimately, though it's based more on dumb luck of getting the right colors to drop than skill in matching to pass levels. Another major drawback for me is there is no way to replay previously beaten levels, so make sure you get that highest score for your stars, or you'll never be able to earn them again.

Awesome game. Challenging and fun! I occasionally buy in-game packs to pass harder levels. In my opinion, there should be more power-ups in the packs for the same price. I realize you guys have to make money, but what we get in those packs just is not enough to last more than a few levels. This is very disappointing. Being a member in a club is great... you can chat with people and also win lots of coins as a group in tournaments.

I am on level 2294 ....and love it!! Yes, it takes more time on levels the higher you go.... that's the challenge! I find that alternating play between this and Candy Crush in the same setting allows time for each to give a life by the time you get back to the other one.... love this game!!!!!! ....and wow.....NO ADS!!!!!

I used to really like this game. However, I quit playing it for a year because I was being charged for something every round. The new puzzles drew me back, but with some feelings of distrust. I really HATE that ads for Toon Blast never change, and go on and on between every round on Word Yahtze. What was a cute set of game scenes the 1st time I saw them are now nothing but ANNOYING. If your sales are falling off, these are the reasons why.

Have enjoyed for several months, I understand the levels get harder the higher you go, but it has gotten to a point where they are literally IMPOSSIBLE to win on your first try. I now get stuck on the same level for days on end!! I'm so tired of it. I will probably end up not playing anymore if the levels continue to be un-winnable!

I like this game bur it can sometimes be upsetting if you are not able to get pastca level It sucks at that point. Your team gets mad at you The team does not always have parentapproved names. Toon blast doesn't do anything to help you out with the issue Upgrades are overpriced Gets boring after awhile. Most games fun goes on forever but this game not really has that type of name of that sort.

Moving devices is a disaster. Still. And coin accumulation is a joke now. Was steady at 1k on coins with most contest and prizes being around coins (which is needed) to all contest being around more free time to play which is obvious designed to make you buy more coins. Was a really fun game, but like all things has turned into more of a business instead.

I have spent nearly 4 years, distracting myself with this game, it no longer distracts, just disappoints and frustrates. It is not a game of skill.. or even chance, it is a game that withholds everything you need to pass a level in the hopes you will buy coins. In our current climate, totally not cool. Everyone wants more than they need!

I found this to be very boring, it's tap blocks to blow them up & clear other objects in the least amount of moves game. Nothing like the ad I saw! Very disappointing, I prefer something a lot more mentally challenging & engaging, this is not it for me! But, if that's your thing, then go for it!

I'm above level 7000 I really enjoy the game. The game did go from no ads to a few to many. But now when I lose a level it won't let me exit. It only allows me to watch an ad or pay 100 coins to have 5 more life's. I'm hoping this is a bug that needs to be worked out. Never had trouble before tho.

I've been playing this game for years now. Don't even want to think about how much $ I've spent on it. It use to be fun and challenging, but recently I feel like the game screws you over, making it so you literally can't win unless you spend $ to buy extras so you can get to the next level. You should be able to win by your skill, not how much $ you're willing to spill into a game. If I wanted to throw all my $ away with nothing but frustration in return, I would just go to a casino. 😡

Harder to clear levels with new updates. Coin rewards drastically reduced. Still an addictive and challenging game, but play at your own risk. You will be wasting a lot of time trying to clear ridiculously hard levels and having to watch ads for extra moves. Yourr b/p will also shoot up. I may dump the game soon if there is no improvement.

Level 1073 can't be accomplished unless you buy a lot of bombs, rockets and disco balls. You need to clear an entire column of blue balloons, four crates of bottles and 20 carrots. There are only five magic hats in the lower right corner and you have to clear all of the other items to get to the magic hats. Ridiculous! Now I know why I uninstalled this game before. You work your butt off for hundreds of hours to get to this level and can't win it unless you spend a lot of money.

Wow - just discovered I've been playing this for two years - to the day! Obviously I love it. Thank you 👍 EDIT: 2yrs later, sadly, this game has become very frustrating. I can only get thru 2 games, before it freezes on me! Not to mention how glitchy it is during play. I've managed to enjoy and progress without having 2 spend $. If it continues being shoddy after this update, I'm gonna have to hand my team over and uninstall. What a shame.

Great time waster; it's fun, strategic, new fresh levels that never get boring. If you need to stay awake this will help you do it. The colors are beautiful and every new obstacle comes with instructions to how to capture it. the graphics are so cute and realistic looking: the space ships get bigger as they get closer and the bird houses explode in a flurry of features and birds everywhere. Help a teammate by giving them a new life at now cost to you and get paid a coin in the process.

I've probably played this game since it's release in 2017 but I can honestly say I've NEVER been as frustrated with it as I have the last 2 months. The legends arena has gotten practically impossible. I'm not bragging when I say I am very good at this game but you wouldn't know it from my lack of progress in the last 2 months. I very much dislike the new update using shields as a perk and very much miss being able to watch ads for extra moves. Sometimes all I need is one move to complete a level

Great game, excellent support. I just wish you didn't lose progress if you have to exit the app during the game. A phone call, the battery dies answering a text message, etc and it boots you out of the game. You keep your levels but lose things like the magic ball. I just got a magic ball and my phone died. Now I am back to 0/10. This is so frustrating. I also play Dominoes and it doesn't do this to me, so I know it's possible.

Look I've been playing this game for very wise sometime! And will never uninstall it like I've done many other games! It's nratbnot boring and always a challenge in many different ways n mind wise as well! As having to concentrate, and each n pick right blockss in correct line in right side ncolumes... It's a real mind game, sees n shoes how well u pay attention n how u concentrate on what ur doing. N on what moves to make n when to make them!

Played this game for such a long time.. and I used to love it, however, with this last update the enjoyment level has definitely fallen. Developers need to listen to the feedback because there are way too many similar games out there. Making a mistake is one thing... keeping it is another.

Still loving it 4 years later. Developers have fixed a few things over that time. I just find I need to swap teams occasionally so that it isn't full of inactive players. It would be good if inactive players dissapeared from teams automatically. If they come back they could rejoin a team.

I've been playing this game for about 7 or 8 years. I'm on a team and am suddenly not on the team. I try to join but it tells me I'm already on the team. But it has started me over completely (i lost all points, bonuses and helps) I'm showing with no team. I'm about to delete because ALL MY HARD WORK IS GONE! And apparently so is my team access. No longer worth the attempt to try! I loved this game until.....

As other users have said, you have made the levels impossible without buying packs. I only ever made a few purchases in order to retain my level. It now appears that you are debiting my bank account without my authorisation. Please review the situation urgently and return my money otherwise I will be forced to denounce you.

Always have a technical issue about updating the game. I can't join any tournament or quest. I loved this game but now I don't know anymore. I can't see my ranking, it is always connection error! I always need to message the customer service then my game will be updated. After playing 3-4 levels my game will be not updated again.

I been playing this game for more than 7 years..!! I'm in level 9563 and I really love it..!! But sometimes you have to wait for the extra bonus and it takes forever to get it..! And when you finally get it and you finally thought you are going to win the level no more extra bonus..!! And I really hate that 🤦‍♀️ time to delete 🤷‍♀️

The game used to be good and addicting until they made changes to the reward system. It was good that they were offering a variety in rewards but the deal breaker is removing almost all kinds of coin rewards. And those coins come in handy when needing to refill lives or add +5 moves to complete a level. Even team challenges and chests don't result in coin rewards any more. There's no incentive to play the game. Good while it lasted I suppose (shrug)

I got addicted fairly quickly. There were a few things that I didn't really understand and I felt like could have been explained better. Like some of the bonus things you can select before a round. But other than that this game was fun, easy to advance, and it doesn't have a bunch of annoying ads.

Great puzzle game! Seems like the Devs are consistently working on making this game playable and enjoyable for the time that hasn't passed yet. One minor critique is if you have to pause the game in the middle of a puzzle, there is a good chance you will lose progress for that puzzle even if you haven't lost, and any helpers you have earned for completing consecutive puzzles in the same life. I would like to see that fixed, like prevent the game from crashing if you have to pause for 5 mins

This is a really cool game and I love playing it everyday. But the only thing is that when it's toon blast and you still have lots of attempts left it makes those arrows to destroy the blocks and all the times you have 5 in the same place and can't destroy all the blocks. Please make it to where all the arrows destroys every blocks.

For a free game it is good. No annoying ads. The futher in the game one goes the more challenging it gets. Can get frustrating sometimes but it is possible to play without spending cash. The updates have a glitch in that it resets the daily challenge so any progress I had made is lost. Sometimes I am unable to play until a new update is available. EDIT TO ADD: Recentl changes has actually taken some of the fun away. The team chest use to give coins, not anymore.

The latest 'update' to include a feature to "earn" 3 additional moves by watching an ad slows the program and ALL my apps on my phone to a near "freeze". I have watched ads to get that "one extra move", then I get gypt because the game freezes after earning my extra moves. I dropped this app. It used to be a game for mindless fun & relaxation, now it feels like pure frustration. 🤷

The game passes the time. Next thing you know. Trapped, stuck on a level. Angry, sometimes confused. Like man what am I gonna do next. As time pass by, you finally hear that voice coming from with in. Yes! I have found the combination. Level completed. On to the next. Sometimes prizes. Just have to keep playing.

Stop sending me advertisement asking me to come back to your game. Well guess what I won't come back playing this useless game. Yes, I used to like playing this game but after you guys kept freezing the game while I played causing me to lose levels and losing my win streak, I decided to delete my progress forever and never play this game anymore. Mind you, I was on maximum levels at that time yet your game still freezes everytime I play. Trashy game!!! Oh yeah, trashy support team 😒

I love this game and have been playing for years. Never have I written a game gripe. However the latest Adventure Chest update has me frustrated. To get the first anchor takes 100 points and the reward is 50 coins. Doesn't sound like a lot but that took forever!!! Three points a game, if you win on the first try (good luck with that), and 34 games later you earn 50 coins. Really creators????? I reward you with my real world money, I would appreciate it if you reward me with worthwhile goals.

Increased price for fewer coins. No longer fun to play. Game glitches when I press on one section of the board another makes a move, or when usong 2 cubes together, not all of the blocks disappear.
